scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete and verifiable final archive for the requested date produces a successful ALREADY-PUBLISHED result.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The fixture-driven CLI regression passed with provider and Telegram environment removed, and a read-only reconstruction of origin/data verified the 2026-08-24 final archive without mutation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The GitHub Actions workflow treats an already-published result as a successful no-op.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Static workflow assertions passed for exact data artifact detection, ALREADY-PUBLISHED acceptance, and the no-Telegram/no-data-write exit path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Pending publication recovery remains a no-second-send path.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Existing pending-ref and prepared-transaction recovery tests passed, and the workflow still accepts READY-TO-PUSH and RECOVERED outcomes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Partial, malformed, conflicting, or unverifiable archive state still fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Archive residue, same-date overwrite, receipt mismatch, and prepared transaction conflict tests passed; the new verifier delegates to the existing fail-closed committed-run check.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: User-facing operations documentation explains the status meanings.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The operations guide describes PUBLISHED, ALREADY-PUBLISHED, READY-TO-PUSH, RECOVERED, and stop-and-inspect archive errors in user-facing terms.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public CLI behavior must be documented and tested.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: docs/operations/WEEKLY_RADAR.md documents --verify-published-as-of and the ALREADY-PUBLISHED outcome; tests/weekly_radar_runtime.rs covers the CLI and workflow regressions.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use the existing archive verifier as the evidence boundary; do not duplicate or weaken archive validation.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/main.rs delegates ALREADY-PUBLISHED to verify_committed_run_read_only; src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/archive.rs reuses the existing fail-closed transaction verifier and adds strict artifact-identity checks for the no-op path.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep provider acquisition and Telegram delivery outside the already-published verification path.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/main.rs returns before provider acquisition and Telegram setup; .github/workflows/weekly-radar.yml exits before Telegram or data-branch write when verification succeeds.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve typed fail-closed errors and no-overwrite behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: src/features/weekly_radar/runtime/archive.rs and tests/weekly_radar_runtime.rs retain same-date overwrite, mismatch, and partial-transaction fail-closed coverage.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not read or record Secret values.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Only non-secret repository files, hosted run URLs, and origin/data artifact identities were used; no Secret value was read or recorded.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not manually modify the data branch or historical production artifacts.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The Work Item diff contains no data branch files; the origin/data archive was copied read-only for verification only.

risk.detail: The workflow change is bounded by full archive verification, no duplicate delivery, preserved pending recovery, and no data or sensitive-value mutation.

observedIssues.detail: The initial no-op path reused a verifier that did not fully bind legacy report, snapshot, receipt, and manifest identities and created lock metadata during a command documented as read-only.
observedIssues.resolution: Added strict report/snapshot/receipt identity validation, transaction manifest binding for the no-op path, a shared report digest, and a truly non-mutating verification entrypoint; added a legacy tamper regression.

observedIssues.area: merge review: malformed receipt attempt values
observedIssues.detail: The strict no-op verifier rejected zero attempts but accepted non-numeric, negative, boolean, null, or fractional attempt values.
observedIssues.resolution: Require every receipt attempt to be a positive unsigned integer and add a legacy-archive regression using a non-numeric attempt value.

observedIssues.area: merge review: same-date transaction manifest coverage
observedIssues.detail: The same-date transaction manifest binding was implemented but had no regression test proving that a manifest mismatch fails closed.
observedIssues.resolution: Add a committed-transaction fixture that tampers the same-date manifest and asserts no ALREADY-PUBLISHED result.

residualRisks.detail: The existing 2026-08-24 report remains unchanged; the next real weekly schedule is still needed to prove the corrected workflow handles a fresh production date and the SEC response-limit fix together.
Creating a new durable external input store before Telegram delivery remains outside this bounded correction; explicit retry still requires the existing durable input snapshot.
